audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why and phases[6].why were boilerplate with no spike behind them.
audit.why: Malphite's spikes are Granite Shield refreshing out of combat, Unstoppable Force at 6 (130s at rank 1) and full-tank scaling for the 5v5. Yorick's is Maiden at 6, which is permanent pressure against an ultimate saved for teamfights.
audit.corrected: Rewrote both to those spikes with the 130s number.

audit.whatIsWrong: Flagged defect — the page names only Unstoppable Force and never Granite Shield, Seismic Shard, Thunderclap or Ground Slam, and gives no cooldowns at all.
audit.why: Granite Shield absorbs 10% of his max health and RECHARGES if he is not hit for a few seconds, so poking him once between trades is worse than not poking at all — that is the single most-missed interaction in the matchup. Seismic Shard steals your move speed for 3 seconds at 625 range on a flat 8s. Ground Slam is a flat 7s and its damage scales with his armour, so it grows as he builds tank. Thunderclap is a 10s auto-reset, so his burst opens on an attack wind-up.
audit.corrected: All four named with cooldowns and the shield-recharge rule in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, report[5].t and the itemization line.

notes: DIRECTION CONFLICT, needs a human call. The mirror (malphite__yorick) settled the chart as Skill / Yorick / Yorick / Skill / Malphite / Malphite / Yorick — i.e. Malphite wins level 6 and first item and Yorick wins 2+ items. The packet chart, this page's whys[4], whys[5], whys[6], spikes[1], spikes[2], spikes[3], mid and late all say the reverse on those three rows. I followed the packet and the prose on rows 4 and 6 rather than rewrite six verified strings to fit the mirror, and left row 5 alone. mirror-fix.js will otherwise decide this silently.
